* Marketingprojekte und Partner koordinieren: Du hältst laufende Projekte zusammen, koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass Aufgaben zuverlässig und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.
* KI und Automatisierung sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools für Recherche, Content, Analysen und operative Aufgaben und entwickelst Ideen, wie wir unsere Marketingprozesse kontinuierlich verbessern können.

**Was diese Rolle besonders macht**
-----------------------------------

* Abwechslung statt Silodenken: Du arbeitest nicht ausschließlich an Content, Performance oder Analytics, sondern lernst unterschiedliche Marketingdisziplinen kennen und verbindest sie miteinander.
* Eigenverantwortung statt langer Abstimmungswege: Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Entscheidungen vorzubereiten und Projekte selbstständig voranzutreiben.
* Kreativität trifft Zahlen: Du kannst neue Kampagnenideen entwickeln und anschließend anhand konkreter Ergebnisse nachvollziehen, ob sie erfolgreich waren.
* Lernen gehört zum Job: Du musst nicht jedes Tool und jeden Marketingkanal bereits kennen. Wir schätzen Menschen, die sich Herausforderungen stellen und neue Fähigkeiten selbstständig aufbauen.
* Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CMO: Du erhältst Einblicke in strategische Marketingentscheidungen und bist eng an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Marketings beteiligt.
* Persönliche Entwicklung und Perspektive: Du wächst mit deinen Aufgaben und hast die Möglichkeit, mit der Weiterentwicklung von Lovebetter zunehmend Verantwortung für größere Projekte, Prozesse und perspektivisch auch Menschen zu übernehmen.

**Dein Impact**
---------------

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

* ein Marketing, in dem gute Ideen schneller in konkrete Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden
* ein Ambassador- und Kooperationsprogramm, das kontinuierlich wächst und messbare Ergebnisse liefert
* neue Marketingkanäle, die strukturiert getestet, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden
* bessere Kampagnen und Inhalte durch die Verbindung von Kreativität und datenbasierten Erkenntnissen
* optimierte Funnels, CRM-Kampagnen und digitale Kontaktpunkte, die mehr qualifizierte Leads erzeugen
* effizientere Prozesse durch Eigeninitiative, Automatisierung und den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI
* ein Marketing-Team, das schneller, selbstständiger und wirkungsvoller arbeitet

**Klingt nach dir?**
--------------------

Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung.

Erzähl uns lieber:

* welche Marketingprojekte oder Kampagnen du bereits eigenständig umgesetzt hast
* wann du dich zuletzt in ein völlig neues Thema oder Tool eingearbeitet hast und was daraus entstanden ist
* wie du kreative Ideen entwickelst und herausfindest, ob sie tatsächlich funktionieren
* welche Aufgaben du schon übernommen hast, obwohl du sie vorher noch nie gemacht hattest
* und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetters Marketing mit Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungskraft auf das nächste Level bringen kannst

**Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)**
----------------------------------

### **Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …**

* du bereits praktische Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing gesammelt und idealerweise Kampagnen oder Projekte eigenständig umgesetzt hast
* du sowohl kreativ als auch analytisch denkst und Spaß daran hast, zwischen unterschiedlichen Aufgaben zu wechseln
* du eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mitbringst und lieber ins Machen kommst, als lange über Möglichkeiten zu diskutieren
* du neugierig bist, schnell lernst und dir neue Tools, Plattformen oder Fähigkeiten eigenständig aneignen kannst
* du auch vor unbekannten Herausforderungen nicht zurückschreckst und den Mut hast, Neues auszuprobieren
* du Marketingkennzahlen verstehst und aus Ergebnissen sinnvolle Schlussfolgerungen ziehen kannst
* du strukturiert und zuverlässig arbeitest, Prioritäten setzen kannst und auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick behältst
* du KI bereits aktiv nutzt oder motiviert bist, sie schnell und sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren
* du sehr gut auf Deutsch kommunizierst und ein Gespür für überzeugende Texte und zielgruppengerechte Ansprache hast
* du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen

### **Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn …**

* du ausschließlich in einer einzelnen Marketingdisziplin arbeiten möchtest und wenig Interesse an anderen Bereichen hast
* du für neue Aufgaben immer eine detaillierte Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung brauchst
* du lieber Konzepte entwickelst, als sie selbst umzusetzen
* du bei unbekannten Tools oder Herausforderungen schnell aufgibst, statt nach Lösungen zu suchen
* du Zahlen ignorierst und Marketingentscheidungen ausschließlich nach Bauchgefühl triffst
* du Verantwortung lieber abgibst, statt Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben
* du mit sensiblen Themen wie Sexualität, Männlichkeit, Beziehungen und persönlicher Entwicklung nicht offen und reflektiert umgehen kannst

job.title: Growth Manager (m/f/d) @ MAOMAO Technologies (Berlin, BE, DE)
job.description:
MAOMAO is building an Asian food discovery platform around our online supermarket, combining e-commerce, content, community and social commerce.

We help people discover new foods, brands, trends and cultures through TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, TikTok Shop, our online shop and our own products.

We're looking for a **Growth Manager (m/f/d)** who wants to take real ownership of our next stage of growth: winning new customers, bringing existing customers back and turning ideas into measurable, profitable results.

You'll work directly with the founders and our existing marketing and content team to decide where we focus, what we test and how we execute.

**Tasks**
---------

**What You'll Do**

**Growth Strategy & Execution**

You will identify growth opportunities and turn them into clear priorities and actionable plans.

This includes:

* defining measurable growth goals together with the founders
* identifying opportunities across customer acquisition, conversion, average order value and repeat purchases
* prioritizing initiatives based on expected impact, effort and cost
* developing experiments with clear responsibilities, timelines and success criteria
* reviewing results and deciding what to improve, scale or stop

You'll connect commercial goals with everyday execution and keep projects moving.

**TikTok Shop & Social Commerce**

Social commerce is an important part of MAOMAO and an area we want to continue growing.

You will work on:

* TikTok Shop campaigns, promotions and Seller Center management
* livestream campaigns, formats and activations
* affiliate and creator collaborations
* product selection, offers and promotional planning
* coordination with TikTok and external partners
* identifying and testing new opportunities

Experience with TikTok Shop is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity, commercial thinking and the ability to learn quickly matter.

**Campaigns, Content & Product Launches**

You will plan and coordinate campaigns, promotions and product launches from idea to execution.

Together with our marketing and content team, you will help decide:

* which products, topics and offers we should focus on
* how we communicate them to our audience
* which content formats and channels make sense
* how campaigns connect across TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, our online shop and email
* how we turn audience interest into purchases

You will create timelines, clarify responsibilities, identify dependencies early and follow through on deliverables.

**Customer Retention & CRM**

You will help give existing customers reasons to come back through:

* email campaigns and customer communication
* customer segmentation and relevant offers
* repeat-purchase and reactivation initiatives
* campaigns connecting product launches, community activities and retention

You'll test different approaches and use the results to improve them.

**Performance, KPIs & Budgets**

You will use data to guide decisions and spending.

This includes:

* tracking relevant business and campaign KPIs
* understanding which activities drive sales and at what cost
* evaluating results with margins, discounts, fees and campaign costs in mind
* managing agreed budgets and recommending how to allocate resources
* communicating results and next steps clearly

You should be comfortable working with numbers, questioning assumptions and turning analysis into action.

**Team & Project Coordination**

You will work with our existing marketing and content team to turn priorities into execution.

You will:

* clarify responsibilities, deadlines and expected outcomes
* keep track of projects and follow up on deliverables
* improve workflows and processes
* support team members with clear briefs and constructive feedback
* coordinate with purchasing and operations so campaigns match stock availability and fulfilment capacity

Depending on your experience, you can take on team leadership from the start or grow into it as your responsibilities expand.

**What Ownership Means at MAOMAO**

Ownership means understanding the goal and thinking through what it takes to achieve it.

If we're launching a product in four weeks, we want someone who asks:

**What are we trying to achieve? Who are we targeting? What's the offer? Which channels should we use? Who owns what? What are the deadlines? What could go wrong? And how will we know whether it worked?**

You won't always have complete information. We value someone who makes informed decisions, proposes solutions and learns through testing.

Not every idea will work. What matters is that we learn, adjust and keep moving.

The mindset we're looking for is:

**“Here is the opportunity. Here are the options. Here is what I recommend we try next — and how we'll measure it.”**

**Requirements**
----------------

**Who We're Looking For**

We're open to candidates from **startups, consulting, banking, growth, e-commerce and digital marketing**.

You should:

* have **at least 2 years of relevant professional experience**
* bring strong analytical and commercial thinking
* have taken ownership of projects and be able to explain your contribution and results
* be highly organized, reliable and proactive
* turn ideas and analysis into structured plans and execution
* prioritize effectively when time and resources are limited
* communicate clearly, follow through and work well with others
* be comfortable working with data, KPIs and budgets
* be willing to experiment, make decisions and learn quickly
* have a strong interest in consumer businesses, e-commerce and social commerce
* be hands-on and enjoy working in a small, fast-moving team
* have **fluent German skills (C1 or native-level)** for our predominantly German-speaking audience
* have strong working proficiency in English

Direct experience in **TikTok Shop, livestreaming, affiliate marketing, CRM, performance marketing or campaign management** is a plus.

If you're coming from consulting or banking, we'd like to understand how you've taken a recommendation through to implementation, or otherwise demonstrated that you can get things done.

Previous team leadership experience is welcome, but not essential. **Chinese language skills are a plus, but not a requirement.**

We care more about how you think, take ownership and deliver results than the university you attended.

You don't need to be an expert in every marketing channel. You do need to learn quickly, understand what matters and take responsibility for outcomes.

**Benefits**
------------

**What We Offer**

* A central role with direct influence on MAOMAO's growth
* Direct collaboration with the founders, with backgrounds in **venture capital and e-commerce**
* An existing marketing and content team to work with
* An established business and active community to build on
* Our own office, warehouse and content setup in Berlin
* Short decision-making paths and the freedom to implement ideas
* Room to experiment with products, offers, content and new channels
* Work at the intersection of **e-commerce, social media, TikTok Shop, livestreaming and brand building**
* Responsibility for projects from the initial idea through to results
* Professional development and the potential to take on more leadership responsibility
* An international team with passion and team spirit
* Employee discount across our assortment

**Interested?**

Send us your **CV and a short introduction** explaining why you want to join MAOMAO and what excites you about this role.

We'd also like you to answer one question:

**Tell us about a project, campaign or experiment you took ownership of. What was the goal, what did you personally do, what was the result, and what did you learn?**

Your example can come from marketing, a startup, consulting, banking or another relevant setting. It doesn't have to be a huge project or a perfect success. We're interested in your decisions, your contribution and how you approach problems.

We don't mind if you use AI to help with your application — we use AI too. But if your application could be sent to 50 other companies by simply replacing the company name, it's probably not for us. **Show us why MAOMAO, and show us how you think.**

If you want to take ownership, move fast and help us grow a category that has been treated as a niche for far too long, we'd love to hear from you.

*Maybe you're the Sriracha to our noodle soup. ️*

job.title: Performance Marketing & Growth Manager – SEA, Meta & Conversion (m/w/d) @ Kalia Lab (Berlin, Berlin, Germany)
job.description:
Du verwaltest Google Ads und Meta nicht einfach nur, sondern verstehst,
**welche Kampagnen, Creatives, Landingpages und Prozesse tatsächlich zu mehr Buchungen und profitablem Wachstum führen**
?

Du kannst tief in Zahlen eintauchen, erkennst Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab? Gleichzeitig bist du hands-on genug, Kampagnen selbst aufzusetzen, Tests umzusetzen und gemeinsam mit Content-, Design- und Operations-Teams Optimierungen schnell auf die Straße zu bringen?

Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Als
**Performance Marketing & Growth Manager**
verantwortest du einen zentralen Teil unserer digitalen Neukundengewinnung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Marketing-Team unsere Paid-, Conversion- und Growth-Aktivitäten kontinuierlich weiter.

**Performance Marketing - Google Ads & Meta/ TikTok**

* Du verantwortest und steuerst unsere
  **Google-Ads- und Paid Social (Meta/ TikTok)-Kampagnen**
  mit Fokus auf Neukundengewinnung, Terminbuchungen und profitables Wachstum.
* Du entwickelst Kampagnenstrukturen, Zielgruppen, Bidding-Strategien und Budgets kontinuierlich weiter.
* Du analysierst Performance auf Kampagnen-, Ad-Set-, Keyword-, Creative-, Treatment- und Standortebene.

  **CAC, CPL, Conversion Rate, ROAS, CTR, CPC und Booking Rate**
  .

**Growth & Analytics**

* Du analysierst die Performance entlang der gesamten Customer Journey – von der ersten Ad Impression bis zur tatsächlichen Terminbuchung.
* Du verbindest Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen und erkennst,
  **wo Wachstum entsteht und an welchen Stellen Nutzer\*innen im Funnel verloren gehen**
  .
* Du gehst regelmäßig tief in unsere Daten, identifizierst Muster, Auffälligkeiten und Wachstumshebel und übersetzt diese in konkrete Maßnahmen.
* Du analysierst Performance nach
  **Channel, Standort, Treatment, Zielgruppe, Creative und Funnel-Step**
  .
* Du bewertest Marketing nicht nur anhand von CAC und ROAS, sondern verbindest Akquisekosten mit Umsatz, Deckungsbeitrag, Wiederbuchungsrate und Customer Lifetime Value.
* Du entwickelst ein Verständnis dafür, welche Patient:innen, Treatments und Akquisekanäle langfristig den höchsten Wert für Kalia Lab schaffen.
* Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Geschäftsführung und weiteren Teams zusammen und bringst deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in strategische Entscheidungen ein.

**Conversion Rate & Funnel Optimierung**

* Du analysierst unsere Website, eigene App, Landingpages und den digitalen Booking Funnel und identifizierst Conversion-Potenziale.
* Du entwickelst Hypothesen zur Optimierung von
  **Landingpages, Angebotsdarstellung, Messaging, UX und Booking-Prozessen**
  .
* Du konzipierst und begleitest A/B-Tests und bewertest deren Ergebnisse datenbasiert.
* Du beschäftigst dich nicht nur mit Traffic, sondern mit der entscheidenden Frage:
  **Wie machen wir aus mehr relevanten Besucher
  *innen auch mehr Patient*
  innen?**
* Du identifizierst Reibungspunkte entlang der Customer Journey und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Lösungen.
* Du bewertest Maßnahmen anhand ihres tatsächlichen Business Impacts und priorisierst entsprechend.

**Creative & Content Performance**

* Du analysierst, welche Creatives, Hooks, Botschaften, Treatments und Formate besonders gut performen.
* Du leitest aus Performance-Daten konkrete
  **Creative- und Content-Briefings**
  für unser Content-Team ab.
* Du verstehst die Verbindung zwischen
  **Ad, Landingpage, Angebot und Conversion**
  und optimierst diese ganzheitlich.
* Du hilfst uns dabei, aus einzelnen erfolgreichen Creatives wiederholbare Learnings und skalierbare Content-Prinzipien zu entwickeln.

**Qualifikation**

* Du hast mindestens
  **2–3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung**
  im Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing, Paid Acquisition oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
* Du hast fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit
  **Google Ads und Meta/ TikTok Ads**
  und hast Kampagnen bereits eigenständig gesteuert und optimiert.
* Du bist ausgesprochen
  **analytisch und zahlengetrieben**
  und fühlst dich wohl dabei, tief in Daten einzusteigen - du leitest daraus
  **konkrete Actions, Tests und Entscheidungen**
  ab.
* Du verstehst zentrale Performance-KPIs und deren Zusammenhänge und kannst erklären, warum sich CAC, Conversion Rate oder ROAS verändern.
* Du hast Erfahrung mit
  **Conversion-Optimierung, Funnel-Analysen und strukturiertem Testing**
  .
* Idealerweise hast du bereits im
  **Consumer-, D2C-, E-Commerce-, Healthcare-, Beauty- oder Dienstleistungsumfeld**
  gearbeitet und kennst Geschäftsmodelle, bei denen eine konkrete Buchung oder Conversion das Ziel ist.
* Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine KPIs und Projekte.
* Du hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und gleichzeitig eine pragmatische
  **Test-and-Learn-Mentalität**

* Du bringst dich proaktiv ein, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und entwickelst eigene Ideen zur Verbesserung.

  **KI-Tools wie Claude (Adspirer)**

**Was uns besonders wichtig ist**

Wir suchen keinen reinen
**Campaign Manager**

Du solltest Spaß daran haben, genau diese Fragen mit Daten zu beantworten und daraus gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Veränderungen umzusetzen.

**Benefits**

* Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit der Geschäftsleitung und kurze Entscheidungswege
* Die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau einer schnell wachsenden Klinikmarke und unserer Marketing- und Growth-Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten
* Sehr großzügige Rabatte für Mitarbeitende auf all unsere Produkte & Leistungen
* **Berlin-central Office in Mitte**
  , Nähe Friedrichstraße

**Bewirb dich jetzt**

Wenn du Lust hast, Performance Marketing nicht nur operativ zu betreiben, sondern als echten
**Wachstumshebel**
zu verstehen und Kalia Lab gemeinsam mit uns weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist
**Caro – Head of Marketing**
.

job.title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager (a) @ Oviva (Berlin, Berlin, Germany)
job.description:
**Why Oviva?**
At Oviva, we’re on a mission to make sustainable, personalized, clinically effective care accessible to everyone as we build Europe’s leading AI-powered chronic care platform. Our digital programmes help people manage weight-related illnesses by focusing on what matters most: improving health, building confidence, and enhancing quality of life.
  
  
To date, we have supported over one million people across the UK, Switzerland, and Germany. Our mission is powered by a dedicated team operating across four countries, including our hub in Poland. Every conversation, coaching session, and line of code brings us closer to a healthier future.
  
  
Our journey is accelerating: In 2026, we secured €200 million in Series D funding led by Kinnevik and a group of leading global investors. This investment fuels our next phase of growth, allowing us to scale our AI-enabled chronic care platform across Europe and expand our support to even more people living with chronic conditions.
  
  
Join us, and be part of the team making that future possible!
  
  
**The role**
The Senior Growth Marketing Manager (a) designs, tests, and expands rapid marketing growth initiatives across Europe to accelerate patient acquisition for our digital health applications (such as our obesity and hypertension programs in Germany). Acting as an entrepreneurial growth hacker, this individual identifies novel acquisition channels, maximizes existing platform performance, and elevates land-to-lead conversion rates (in close collaboration with our dedicated product & engineering squad). This position directly advances our mission of making personalised, clinical care accessible to everyone by building a robust, repeatable pipeline of new patient leads.
  
  
In this role, you will enjoy a high degree of autonomy, balancing strategic planning with a hands-on approach to executing initiatives. You will act as a subject matter expert within the Marketing team, fostering a culture of high performance and evidence-based decision-making.
  
  
You will find and involve the right experts and agencies for new channels and initiatives to ensure we learn best practices as a key part of our expansion strategy.
  
  
**Requirements:**
**Essential**

* Growth Hacking & Rapid Experimentation Mastery: A proven track record of managing data-driven marketing initiatives and scaling paid digital acquisition channels from inception to maturity. This includes executing rapid experimentation frameworks across new channels,and driving conversion rate optimization where it makes sense.
* Commercial Acumen & Financial Modeling: Strong capability to build data-driven financial business cases that translate long-term commercial goals into clear, actionable roadmaps. Demonstrated experience balancing aggressive customer acquisition scale with strict Cost Per Lead targets to continuously improve core business metrics based on analytical insights.
* Advanced Analytics & Growth Architecture: Exhibit a deeply analytical mindset with the technical expertise to design growth automation workflows, manage complex data visualisation tools, and leverage AI tools to maximise cross-functional efficiency
* Agile Problem-Solving & Resourcefulness: Exceptional agility to navigate highly ambiguous, fast-moving environments and drive immediate execution ("today rather than next week"). Proven ability to identify and collaborate with external expert networks or specialized agencies to integrate state-of-the-art testing practices, combined with the resourcefulness to independently source freelance talent or AI tools when internal team capacity is stretched.
* Minimum Viable Product Testing & Lifecycle Handover: Ability to launch nimble, unpolished baseline experiments to validate initial growth hypotheses without demanding perfect workflows upfront. Possesses the strategic capability to transition successful pilots into structured future-state processes, followed by sourcing, onboarding, and training internal talent to fully own the mature channel long-term.

**Desirable**

* Experience navigating performance marketing regulations within the healthcare or German digital health application sector.
* An established professional network of digital marketing experts, freelancers, and agile agencies.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in economics, statistics, (business) informatics, or a related field
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in performance marketing or growth hacking, preferably in a B2C startup environment
* Language Qualifications: German C1+ and fluency in English

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify and Validate Growth Opportunities: Discover and map new acquisition channels (e.g., partnerships, influencer marketing, programmatic), aggressively expand existing channels, and execute conversion rate optimization strategies through deep personalization of landing pages and lead surveys (where needed). This role stays up to date on new trends in existing channels & potential new channels by monitoring ad platform changes, competitors and the overall market.
* Construct Robust Business Cases: Build high-level commercial business cases for every new testing initiative, establishing clear parameters for target scale and acceptable Cost Per Lead boundaries that successfully transition channels from experimentation to maturity.
* Own and Establish State-of-the-Art Testing Protocols: Architect world-class testing methodologies and integrate automated tools or AI applications, establishing institutional best practices that elevate the performance marketing capabilities
* Execute Minimum Viable Product Experiments: Launch fast, agile experiments to validate core hypotheses without demanding flawless internal processes initially, moving rapidly to define the long-term operational vision once lead volume and scalability are proven.
* Drive Fast-Paced Execution: Maintain an exceptional bias for action to push initiatives forward today rather than tomorrow, breaking through resource bottlenecks by independently sourcing freelance talent or leveraging AI tools when internal capacity is stretched.
* Lead Channel Lifecycle & Strategic Handover: Drive the end-to-end strategy for scaling promising initiatives from ad view to conversion. Define the future-state operational infrastructure, build training documentation, and seamlessly onboard team members to manage mature channels
* Stakeholder Engagement: Foster strong collaboration with key stakeholders, both within Oviva’s marketing team to share insights and best practices, and with external teams and stakeholders, driving and contributing to cross-functional projects.

**Job Benefits**

* The opportunity to drive meaningful, life-changing impact through your work.
* A high-growth environment with strong development opportunities.
* Flexible working options – including remote working.
* Personal learning budget and development plans.
* A home working allowance to create your ideal workspace.
* Competitive salary (shared in the first screening call) and benefits

job.title: Strategy Lead - Acquisition @ iwoca Deutschland (Berlin, Berlin, Germany)
job.description:
**The company**

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

**The team**

The Acquisition Strategy and Tech team is the integrated growth engine for iwoca in Germany. We bridge the gap between high-level commercial strategy and the technical systems that power our customer journey. By combining growth analytics, performance modeling, and full-stack engineering, we own the end-to-end acquisition funnel – from the very first touchpoint to a completed loan application. Our Core Focus:

Strategic Growth & Analytics: We serve as the central hub for our Direct Marketing and Sales channels. We translate complex data into actionable strategies, ensuring our outreach is both scalable and profitably managed.

Technical Infrastructure: We build and maintain the proprietary systems and models that drive our German operations. This includes optimizing the "User Experience" (UX) to ensure a frictionless onboarding process for small businesses.

Operational Excellence: We connect the dots between data-driven decision-making and real-world commercial impact. Our mission is to ensure every potential customer receives a clear, relevant, and rapid understanding of how iwoca can fund their business.

We are a fast-moving, cross-functional unit designed to turn strategic hypotheses into measurable results. Whether it’s refining a marketing model or shipping a new feature in the application journey, we ensure that iwoca’s expansion in the German market is backed by robust tech and a clear commercial North Star.

**The role**

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, data, and technology. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will lead a high-performing, interdisciplinary team of three and own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market. Your primary objective is to co-define the growth strategy and partner closely with engineering and data teams to build the systems, onboarding journeys, and experiments that bring that strategy to life.

The scope of this role is broad and we're not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning strategy, analytics, product development, and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

You'll define hypotheses, lead cross-functional initiatives, and own the roadmap for how iwoca engages with German businesses. You will be accountable for measurable impact on acquisition and conversion, bringing ideas to life through rigorous commercial insight, strong customer empathy, and practical delivery. As a Lead, you will also be responsible for coaching your team and establishing the operating rhythm for this new unit.

**Market and problem understanding**

* Deeply understand the German SME lending landscape, customer needs, and competitive context to sharpen our go-to-market strategy.
* Translate market and customer insight into clearly defined product problems and prioritised commercial opportunities.
* Inform targeting and segmentation strategies to help Marketing and Sales reach the right customers.

**Product build and optimisation**

* Own the roadmap for acquisition and onboarding, working with engineers and data scientists to develop tools such as lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers, and onboarding journeys.
* Work with marketing and sales to evolve website content, sign-up flows, and decisioning logic to increase conversion.
* Influence future team capability by helping define priorities, roles, and processes as we scale.

**Experimentation and insight**

* Design, run, and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, onboarding tools, and product flows.
* Identify opportunities using first-principle reasoning supported by data, customer research, and funnel analysis.

**Cross-functional collaboration**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of at the beginning two commercial strategy analysts and a data scientist focused on acquisition strategy and operational excellence.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning engineering, data, marketing, and commercial stakeholders around clear goals, hypotheses, and success metrics.
* Translate high-level business goals into testable hypotheses and actionable briefs for our technical teams.
* Help establish the operating rhythm, rituals, and roadmap processes for this new team.

**The requirements**

Essential:

* Strong commercial mindset with proven experience driving go-to-market strategy and measurable acquisition growth.
* Experience in growth strategy, revenue operations, or a highly analytical commercial role with a track record of driving tech-enabled or product-led growth.
* Proven people management or team leadership experience, with the ability to build culture and establish operating rhythms in a newly formed team.
* Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments.
* Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.
* Experience working with (or a strong desire to learn about) technical models such as lead scoring, predictive targeting, or qualification logic.
* Ability to work from first principles and thrive in ambiguity with curiosity and autonomy.

Bonus:

* Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products.
* Experience working closely with engineering, product, or data science teams to ship features or models.
* Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.

**The culture**

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

**The offices**

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

* Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
* Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

**The benefits**

A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with ridiculous growth-mindset.

26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

€30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket.

Company Pension with Canada Life.

Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

Corporate Benefits discounts.

’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

* A learning and development budget for everyone, including a book budget.
* Learning German budget.
* Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.
* Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Deine Arbeit wechselt zwischen Vorbereitung, Produktion und Postproduktion.

* du kreativ bist, aber trotzdem gerne mit klaren Briefings arbeitest,

job.title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d) @ Störtebekker (Frankfurt, Hesse, Germany)
job.description:
Du brennst für Social Media, triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert und liebst es, starke Ideen blitzschnell und verlässlich auf die Straße zu bringen? Dann wirst Du Dich hier wohlfühlen.

  

**Unser Ziel:**

  

350.000 auf 1 Mio. Follower skalieren – mit zielgruppenspezifischen Content (v.a. Fokus auf Short Videos), datengetriebenen Entscheidungen und einem starken Team. Wenn Du weißt, wie Social Media Wachstum funktioniert, lies weiter.

  

**Deine Mission:**

  

Du entwickelst die Content-Strategie für unsere neue Brand-Ausrichtung und bringst TikTok, YouTube und Instagram auf Wachstumskurs. Statt Bestehendes nur zu verwalten, hast du bei uns die Freiheit, neue Formate zu testen und unser Team aus Community Management, Video-Agentur und Grafikern zu steuern. Perfekt für Dich, wenn Du ein System neu aufbauen und echtes Wachstum gestalten willst.

  

**Aufgaben**

  

  
* **Social Media Ownership:**
  Du steuerst TikTok, Youtube und Instagram, testest Formate und optimierst auf Wachstum.
  
* **Growth & Analytics:**
  Du analysierst Inhalte, erkennst Muster und steuerst Views & Follower bewusst.
  
* **Pulse of the Community:**
  Du bist ganz nah dran an unserer Zielgruppe, reagierst blitzschnell auf Trends und stärkst Beziehungen mit Humor und authentischem Ton.
  
* **Creator Relations:**
  Du scoutest passende Gesichter vor der Kamera und steuerst Agenturen & Partner.
  

  

**Deine Ziele:**

  

**In den ersten 3 Monaten:**

  

  
* **Strategische Weichenstellung:**
  Du evaluierst unser bestehendes Setup und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit uns die neue, zukunftsfähige Content-Strategie.
  
* **Testing & Validierung:**
  Du testest neue Content-Ansätze und etablierst eine klare Bewertungssystematik für deren Erfolg.
  
* **Struktur & Tracking:**
  Du etablierst ein lückenloses Tracking- & Optimierungssetup, das uns erlaubt, Content ab Tag 1 datenbasiert zu steuern.
  
* **Steuerung von Partnern:**
  Du übernimmst die Steuerung von Community Manager, Video-Agentur und Grafiker.
  
* **Wachstum:**
  Du erzeugst erste sichtbare Wachstumsimpulse über unsere Kernkanäle.
  

  

**Nach 12 Monaten:**

  

  
* **Skalierung:**
  Du hast unsere Kanäle von 350.000 auf 500.000+ Follower weiterentwickelt – mit einem stabilen, wiederholbaren Wachstumssystem basierend auf unserer neuen Brand-Ausrichtung.
  
* **Planbares Social Growth:**
  Du stehst für datengetriebenes Wachstum: klare KPIs, wöchentliche Analysen und performancebasierte Entscheidungen. Du weißt genau, welche Formate funktionieren und warum.
  
* **Infrastruktur & Kanäle:**
  Du hast kanalindividuellen Strategien erfolgreich umgesetzt und die dafür notwendigen Stakeholder fest im Griff.
  

  

**Qualifikation**

  

  
* Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft o.ä.
  
* 2-3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Social Media Wachstum mit klar belegbaren Ergebnissen.
  
* Content-DNA: Du weißt, welche Formate performen, wie Algorithmen funktionieren und welche Trends relevant sind.
  
* Analytische Stärke: Du kombinierst Kreativität immer mit Daten.
  
* Ownership & Speed: Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und treibst Projekte ohne Micro-Management voran.
  
* Growth Mindset: Du willst skalieren, testen und optimieren.
  

  

**Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn Du …**

  

  
* Social Media eigenständig voranbringst statt „Content zu verwalten“.
  
* genau weißt, wie man Reichweite, Follower und Engagement steuert.
  
* nie stagnierst – Du testest, optimierst, entwickelst weiter.
  
* relevante Stakeholder zuverlässig koordinierst.
  
* datenbasiert arbeitest und Learnings dokumentierst.
  
* Energie, Humor und Drive ins Team bringst.
  

  

**Wir sind kein Match, wenn …**

  

  
* Du keine Erfahrungen für Social Growth nachweisen kannst.
  
* Du Social eher kreativ statt analytisch steuerst.
  
* Dein Perfektionismus Dich blockiert und es bei Dir lange dauert, bis besprochene Themen wirklich live gehen.
  
* Deadlines und eine extrem hohe Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit Dich stressen.
  
* Community-Arbeit für Dich lästig statt energiefördernd ist.
  

  

**Benefits**

  

  
* **Flexibles Arbeiten:**
  Arbeite aus unserem Büro im Frankfurter Ostend oder hybrid.
  
* **Startup Vibes & Gestaltungsspielraum:**
  Übernimm Verantwortung, bring Deine Ideen ein und nutze echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  
* **Teamwork:**
  Du arbeitest eng mit einem ambitionierten Brand Team.
  
* **Benefits:**
  Wellpass, Bikeleasing, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Corporate Benefits, Afterworks, Teamevents
  
* **Feedback & Wertschätzung:**
  Erlebe eine offene Feedback-Kultur und ehrliche Anerkennung für Deinen Einsatz.
  

  

**Bereit, mit uns die 1 Mio. Follower zu knacken? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt!**

job.title: Social Media Manager - TikTok & Instagram @ KittySpout (Berlin, Berlin, Germany)
job.description:
**KittySpout / DoggySpout**
is looking for a
**Social Media Manager**
to join our team! You will own organic social for both brands end to end across every social channel. You decide what each account is for, who it should bring in and what content grows it. Then you plan it, create it, publish it every day and adjust based on what the numbers tell you. This isn't a role for keeping the lights on: we want someone who will transform our socials and turn them into a super-engaged community that people actually want to be part of.
  
  
You report to our Influencers & Partnerships Manager and have a designer for bigger creative pieces, but the thinking is yours and you're strong on graphics and short-form video yourself. We are looking for someone with
**2+ years**
running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand, who has personally created and published the content and can show the accounts they grew and the numbers they moved.
  
  
**The mission of this role**
Own organic social for KittySpout and DoggySpout end to end across all social media channels. Success is accounts that keep growing and reach people who have never heard of us, with content created and published every day that grows an active, engaged community.
  
  
**Who are we?**
KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
  
  
**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**
Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
  
  

* Better Everyday - test a new format, hook or post style every week, keep what works and improve the calendar and reporting along the way
* Speed Is King - get a trend live the day it's spotted, publish on time every day and answer the community within 24 hours
* Work Smart - use AI and tools so your time goes to strategy and creating: batch and schedule posts ahead, let Claude draft hook and caption variations, and automate the Monday report
* Overdeliver - bring new content ideas to the Influencers & Partnerships Manager before being asked, and tell the team fast when something flops and what you're changing

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.**
If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.
  
  
**Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)**
*90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.*

* Grow the audience on both brands - follower growth by brand and platform (Instagram, TikTok and Facebook insights)
* Reach people who have never heard of us - reach and non-follower reach per post by brand (platform insights)
* Content people save and share - saves, shares and engagement rate by brand (platform insights)
* Publish daily to plan on both brands - posts published per week per brand vs the content calendar (scheduling tool)
* An active, responsive community - comments and DMs answered within 24 hours, Facebook group activity (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok)

**Key Objectives**

* Own the organic content strategy for KittySpout and DoggySpout across all social media channels
* Plan the content calendar one week ahead per brand and platform, mixing content for the existing community with content built to reach new audiences
* Create and publish every day: write the hooks and captions, shoot and edit short-form video, and design day-to-day graphics and stories
* Spot trends daily and get trend content live the same day
* Turn the creator and UGC content from our creator programs into organic posts that perform
* Run the community: comments, DMs, our Facebook group and tagged mentions
* Read the data every week and act on it: double down on what works and drop what doesn't

**Requirements**

* Fully remote, full-time
* Native-level written English
* Hands-on Organic Social: 2+ years personally running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand - creating and publishing the content yourself, not just approving it or managing an agency
* Proof: Accounts you grew and numbers you moved. We will ask for this
* Multi-brand, Multi-platform: You can run two brands across every social channel and tailor content to each instead of copying the same post everywhere
* Design: You build clean, on-brand graphics and stories in Canva, Figma or similar without waiting on a designer
* Hooks, Captions & Video: You write hooks that stop the scroll and shoot and edit short-form video to a solid standard
* Trend Spotting: You're on TikTok and Instagram every day and spot trends before they peak
* Data-driven: You read saves, shares, reach and engagement and change what you make because of it
* Time Zone: Overlap with the US and Canada, where most of our audience is
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder
* Bonus points: pet, home or wellness brand experience; working with creators or UGC

**Accountabilities**
*What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.*

* Content strategy and calendar - Own the organic content strategy for both brands, plan next week's calendar per brand and platform and get it approved with the Influencers & Partnerships Manager, and get trend content live the same day
* Create and publish daily - Write the hooks and captions, shoot and edit short-form video, design day-to-day graphics and stories, brief bigger pieces to the designer in advance, and follow brand guidelines and approved product claims on every post. Nothing missed, nothing late
* Creator content - Review the creator and UGC content coming in from our creator programs, repurpose the best of it for organic, and feed back to the creator team on what works
* Community - Reply to all comments and DMs within 24 hours across both brands, keep the Facebook group active, engage with tagged mentions, and flag customer issues to Customer Support the same day
* Planning and reporting - Post daily priorities, deliver a performance report every Monday (what worked, what didn't and what you're changing), set organic social KPI targets with the Influencers & Partnerships Manager and update them on the department scorecard weekly, and join the weekly team meeting

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

* Application + Screening
* Test Project
* Technical Interview
* Culture Fit Interview

**Salary Expectation**
**USD $3,000 - $4,500 per month (based on experience and expertise).**
